entries.label: BC first-time home buyers program exemption cap
entries.notes: Full exemption = $8,000 = PTT on first $500,000 of value. FMV <=$500K pays $0.
entries.source_note: gov.bc.ca exemption amounts page, fetched directly (verified 2026-09-29).

entries.label: BC FTHB exemption thresholds and phase-out
entries.notes: Flat $8,000 for FMV $500K-$835K. Proportional phase-out $835K-$860K (exemption = 8,000*(860,000-FMV)/25,000; e.g. $836K->$7,680, $850K->$3,200). Zero at $860K. Scales by eligible ownership share; 0.5-ha acreage rule reduces eligible FMV.
entries.source_note: gov.bc.ca exemption amounts page with full phase-out table, fetched directly (verified 2026-09-29).

entries.label: BC newly built home exemption thresholds
entries.notes: Effective Apr 1 2024. Full exemption to $1.1M FMV; partial to $1.15M. Open to anyone (not just first-timers); citizen/PR; principal residence; occupy within 92 days; 1-year occupancy; land <=0.5 ha. Cannot be combined with FTHB exemption.
entries.source_note: gov.bc.ca page, updated Jan 6 2026 (verified 2026-09-29 via corroborating search result).
entries.value: Full to $1,100,000; partial to $1,150,000; mutually exclusive with FTHB exemption

entries.label: BC foreign buyer additional property transfer tax
entries.notes: 20% on top of regular PTT in specified regions (Metro Vancouver, Fraser Valley, Capital RD, Central Okanagan, Nanaimo). No exemptions except limited cases.
entries.source_note: Secondary-sourced only, not verified against gov.bc.ca (verified 2026-09-29).
